assets/advanced/topic_3_01.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The stress associated with the onset</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">of specified permanent deformation</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">in a material.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Mechanical properties</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_02.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A material's resistance to crack</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">extension, expressed using a</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">suitable fracture-mechanics</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">parameter.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Mechanical properties</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_03.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The capacity of a material to</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">undergo substantial plastic</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">deformation before fracture.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Mechanical properties</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_04.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A tendency to fracture with little</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">preceding plastic deformation.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Mechanical properties</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_05.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Dependence of a material property on</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">the direction in which it is</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">measured.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Direction and time dependence</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_06.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Independence of a material property</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">from direction at the scale and</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">conditions considered.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Direction and time dependence</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_07.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A time-dependent mechanical response</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">combining elastic recovery with</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">viscous behaviour.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Direction and time dependence</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_08.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Time-dependent deformation under a</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">sustained load or stress, often</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">important at elevated temperature.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Direction and time dependence</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_09.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Surface damage produced by small-</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">amplitude oscillatory relative</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">motion between contacting surfaces.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Contact and surface damage</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_10.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Severe adhesive surface damage</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">involving local material transfer</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">between sliding contacting surfaces.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Contact and surface damage</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_11.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The breaking away of flakes or</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">fragments from a surface layer.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Contact and surface damage</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_12.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Separation between layers or along</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">an interface in a layered material</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">or assembly.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Contact and surface damage</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_13.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Progressive damage and possible</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">cracking caused by repeated or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">fluctuating loading.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Failure and defects</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_14.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An instability involving a change in</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">structural configuration under load,</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">often with sudden lateral</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">deflection.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Failure and defects</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_15.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Formation and collapse of vapour</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">cavities when local liquid pressure</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">falls sufficiently low.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Failure and defects</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_16.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The presence or proportion of void</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">space within a material.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Failure and defects</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_17.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The complex ratio of voltage to</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">current for a specified electrical</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">response, combining resistive and</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">reactive effects.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Electrical response</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_18.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The reciprocal of impedance; the</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">complex ratio of current to voltage.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Electrical response</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_19.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The imaginary component of</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">electrical impedance associated with</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">inductive or capacitive energy</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">storage.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Electrical response</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_20.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">In magnetics, a quantity relating</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">magnetic flux density to magnetic</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">field strength under specified</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">conditions.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Electrical response</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_21.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Dependence of a system's present</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">response on its previous states or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">input history.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Dynamic behaviour</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_22.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Lost motion during reversal caused</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">by clearance between mating</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">mechanical components.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Dynamic behaviour</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_23.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A heightened response near a</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">system's resonant frequency under</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">suitable excitation.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Dynamic behaviour</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_24.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Mechanisms that dissipate energy or</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">reduce oscillatory response.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Dynamic behaviour</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_25.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The indistinguishability of</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">different continuous-time frequency</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">components after sampling under</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">unsuitable conditions.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Sampling and numerics</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_26.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Mapping a continuous or finer set of</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">amplitude values onto a finite or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">coarser set of levels.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Sampling and numerics</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_27.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A measure of how sensitive a</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">problem's solution is to specified</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">small changes in its input data.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Sampling and numerics</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_28.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Describing a problem whose solution</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">can change greatly after small</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">perturbations of its input.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Sampling and numerics</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_29.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The ability to determine a system's</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">internal state from its available</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">outputs and known inputs over time.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Modelling and control</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_30.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The ability to drive a system</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">between arbitrary states using</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">admissible inputs within the</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">relevant model.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Modelling and control</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_31.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The possibility of determining model</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">parameters uniquely from the</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">available input-output information</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">under stated assumptions.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Modelling and control</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_32.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A linear-system property allowing</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">asymptotic stabilisation by</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">feedback; any uncontrollable modes</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">must already be asymptotically</text><text x="24" y="185" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">stable.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Modelling and control</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_33.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Resistance to the onset of permanent</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">deformation does not by itself</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">establish crack resistance.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Mechanical properties</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_34.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Existing flaws make resistance to</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">crack extension a critical material</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">requirement.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Mechanical properties</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_35.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A material sustains significant</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">irreversible deformation before</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">breaking.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Mechanical properties</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_36.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Fracture occurs with little prior</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">irreversible deformation or visible</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">warning.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Mechanical properties</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_37.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A measured property changes with</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">orientation, so one directional</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">value is insufficient.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Direction and time dependence</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_38.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A direction-independent material</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">model is unsuitable when properties</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">differ with orientation.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Direction and time dependence</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_39.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A material combines elastic and</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">viscous responses, making loading</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">history and rate important.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Direction and time dependence</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_40.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Deformation grows with time under a</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">sustained load rather than requiring</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">repeated load cycles.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Direction and time dependence</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_41.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Tiny repeated relative movements</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">damage surfaces that appear to be</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">firmly clamped.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Contact and surface damage</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_42.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Sliding contact produces severe</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">adhesion and material transfer that</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">can cause seizure.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Contact and surface damage</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_43.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Fragments detach from a surface,</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">leaving local pits or missing</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">material.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Contact and surface damage</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_44.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Layers separate along an internal</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">interface rather than necessarily</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">breaking through each layer.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Contact and surface damage</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_45.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Repeated loading can initiate</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">cracking without requiring the peak</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">stress to exceed the yield strength.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Failure and defects</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_46.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A slender structure loses stability</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">before its material necessarily</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">yields in compression.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Failure and defects</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_47.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Low local liquid pressure creates</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">vapour cavities whose collapse can</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">damage nearby surfaces.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Failure and defects</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_48.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Internal voids reduce the solid</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">fraction without necessarily</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">changing the external dimensions.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Failure and defects</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_49.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The voltage-to-current relationship</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">includes both resistance and</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">frequency-dependent reactive</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">effects.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Electrical response</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_50.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Using the complex current-to-voltage</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">ratio makes parallel branches easier</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">to combine.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Electrical response</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_51.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The energy-storage component of</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">impedance changes with frequency</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">independently of ideal resistance.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Electrical response</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_52.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The local relationship between</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">magnetic flux density and field</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">strength depends on the operating</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">point.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Electrical response</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_53.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Identical present input values can</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">give different responses because the</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">prior history differs.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Dynamic behaviour</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_54.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Mechanical clearance produces a dead</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">interval after the direction of</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">motion is reversed.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Dynamic behaviour</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_55.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Periodic excitation near a lightly</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">damped mode can cause a particularly</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">large response.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Dynamic behaviour</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_56.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Greater energy dissipation</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">suppresses oscillation; other</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">dynamic properties may also change.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Dynamic behaviour</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_57.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Sampling causes a higher-frequency</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">disturbance to masquerade as a</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">lower-frequency signal.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Sampling and numerics</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_58.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Restricting amplitudes to discrete</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">levels introduces error separately</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">from the timing of samples.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Sampling and numerics</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_59.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A numerical sensitivity measure</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">predicts strong amplification of</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">small input perturbations.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Sampling and numerics</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_60.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The problem is highly sensitive to</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">input uncertainty, not merely to</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">arithmetic round-off.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Sampling and numerics</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_61.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Available measurements no longer</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">uniquely reveal the internal state.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Modelling and control</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_62.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">One state direction cannot be moved</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">as required using the available</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">input.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Modelling and control</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_63.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Available observations cannot</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">distinguish multiple parameter</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">combinations in the model.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Modelling and control</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_3_64.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#755c94" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#755c94"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C1–C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Feedback can stabilise the model</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">even though a stable mode cannot be</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">controlled.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#755c94">Modelling and control</text></svg>
